The '''Purala system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Purala IV]].
